steps.description: Load /eval-four-models-without-total-rna-highdup-n6-1/data/inputs/counts/counts.csv (gene symbols in column 1, 12 sample columns) and /eval-four-models-without-total-rna-highdup-n6-1/data/inputs/metadata/metadata.csv (12 rows, condition column). steps.name: DESeq2 treated vs control with sample_01 sensitivity

steps.context: Primary analysis for the research question. 6 treated vs 6 control, unpaired, single batch — no covariates beyond condition. caveats: Only genes surviving the T1S1 filter enter the ranking, so gene-set coverage is reduced relative to a full transcriptome; state the universe used

plan.title: Heart treated vs control bulk RNA-seq DE
plan.analytical_narrative: The question is a two-group differential expression on a small bulk RNA-seq matrix: 12,000 genes x 12 human heart samples (counts.csv, gene symbols in column 1) with metadata.csv giving 6 treated vs 6 control, unpaired, single batch. Two data facts drive the plan's shape. First, the flagged >60% duplication rate: these are rRNA-depleted total RNA libraries WITHOUT UMIs, so duplication cannot be resolved read-by-read, and deduplicating a no-UMI library is the wrong move because it discards true reads from the most highly expressed genes. High duplication in a heart total-RNA library is the expected consequence of low complexity plus a skewed transcript distribution (sarcomeric and mitochondrial transcripts dominate; rRNA depletion leaves residual structural RNA). T1S1 therefore does not dedupe; it quantifies the consequence — counts concentration, residual rRNA/MT fraction — and tests whether complexity is confounded with condition, because if it is, fold changes carry a compositional component that must be reported. Second, sample_01 is ~4x below median depth. With n=6 per arm, dropping a sample costs real power, so T1S1 adjudicates it on evidence (shallow-but-concordant vs compositional outlier in vst/correlation space) and T1S2 runs the leave-it-out refit as a pre-specified sensitivity analysis rather than a reflex exclusion. DESeq2 with median-of-ratios normalisation and apeglm shrinkage is the primary test; edgeR quasi-likelihood in T1S3 is an independent cross-check because a single method's hit list at n=6 should not be reported unqualified. T2S1 takes the full ranked list into fgsea against the staged human MSigDB hallmark, GO:BP and human WikiPathways collections (all confirmed present, HGNC symbols matching the counts.csv identifier space) — a ranked test rather than over-representation, since the per-gene FDR list may be short. The design (6v6, unpaired, single batch, no dose or time axis) supports association between the condition label and expression, and the reporting must say so.
